evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.9 ppm after remaining approximately 3–6 ppm during the ramp.
Oxygen rose to 20.3 ppm during growth, following 6.7 and 13.4 ppm at 2520 and 2640 s.
Oxygen continued rising to 33.3 ppm, from 25.9 ppm at 2880 s, indicating loss of the established low-oxygen atmosphere.
Temperature 750.1 °C and Ar 100.5 sccm track setpoints; pressure is stable at 760.6 Torr, heater power is 45.7%, and controller still reports running.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and leak/inlet-gas checks are needed to distinguish air ingress from gas contamination, outgassing, or oxygen sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
